spec.description: Kafka broker, JVM, Network metrcs

spec.title: Kafka Process CPU Usage
spec.description: CPU used by Kafka JVM process. Detect broker CPU saturation.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: Total host CPU utilization. Useful for distinguishing JVM issues from overall machine saturation.

spec.title: JVM Heap used & max
spec.description: Actual JVM heap currently in use by kafka & max available to kafka

spec.title: JVM Heap Utilization %
spec.description: % of heap utilized. Primary Kafka memory health metric. Sustained high values indicate memory pressure and GC risk.

spec.title: JVM Non-Heap Usage
spec.description: JVM overhead memory including Metaspace and Code Cache.

spec.title: JVM Thread Count
spec.description: Active/daemon/ Kafka JVM threads. Useful for thread leak detection.

spec.title: File descriptors (FD)
spec.description: Kafka uses FDs for logs, sockets and replication connections

spec.title: File descriptors (FD) %
spec.description: Critical Kafka operational metric. Alerts before FD exhaustion.

spec.title: Available CPUs
spec.description: Number of CPUs visible to the Kafka process. Useful as capacity reference.

spec.title: Free memory
spec.description: Available RAM on the host/container

spec.title: Load Average (normalised)
spec.description: Load avg. divided by CPU cores (reported as %)

spec.title: Broker Uptime
spec.description: Time since Kafka broker startup. Detects restarts and instability.

spec.title: Bytes in per second
spec.description: Total inbound traffic received from producers and replication traffic. Primary write-throughput metric.

spec.title: GC per second
spec.description: Represents the total number of garbage collection events that have occurred. No time or memory units apply to this metric. calculates the average number of young generation G1 garbage collections per second over the last 5 minutes

spec.title: GC Time spent
spec.description: Total time Kafka spends performing GC (in milliseconds).

spec.title: Last GC Pause
spec.description: Latest GC pause duration. Directly impacts producer and consumer latency.

spec.title: G1 Old Gen Usage
spec.description: Tracks long-lived Kafka objects. Increasing values often precede memory problems.

spec.title: Bytes out per second
spec.description: Total outbound traffic sent to consumers and follower replicas. Primary read-throughput metric.

spec.title: Messages in per second
spec.description: Number of messages accepted by the broker per second. Useful for throughput analysis.

spec.title: Produce Requests Rate
spec.description: Producer requests arriving at the broker. Helps understand producer workload patterns.

spec.title: Fetch (read) Requests Rate
spec.description: Consumer fetch requests arriving at the broker. Useful for read traffic analysis.

spec.title: Replication Traffic In
spec.description: Traffic received from leader brokers during partition replication.

spec.title: Rejected Bytes Rate
spec.description: Bytes rejected by Kafka. Should normally remain zero.

spec.title: Replication Traffic Out
spec.description: Traffic sent to follower brokers for replication.
